title: Reproducibility archive for Data-Augmented Gibbs Sampling for EXNEX Log-Normal Survival Models in Basket Trials with Right-Censored Endpoints
description: Analysis scripts, fixed inputs, archived fit summaries, evidence exports, and figures for the article on exnexSurv, a data-augmented Gibbs sampler for EXNEX log-normal survival models in basket trials with right-censored endpoints. Funding: CAPES, Finance Code 001.
